## What v2 provides

The workspace preserves product knowledge, intended outcomes, plans, and human decisions in ordinary Markdown and YAML. Root instructions keep authorization boundaries active; skills carry stage-specific procedures. The native CLI provides deterministic mechanics.

## Start using it

Follow [install the template](/docs/get-started/install), [initialize a workspace](/docs/get-started/initialize), and [connect repositories](/docs/get-started/connect-repositories). Then take one change through the [first workflow](/docs/get-started/first-workflow).

## Version baseline

This major guide is verified against template 2.5.0. Read the [2.5.0 release notes](/releases/template/2.5.0) for the launcher and the archive, the [2.4.0 release notes](/releases/template/2.4.0) for schema 3 and banded members, or the [template changelog](/changelog/template) for each v2 release.

No v1 guide is available here. Applying a template upgrade uses the tag delta between the recorded tag and a later tag on the same release line, and preserves the project's own files. Moving to another release line happens only when a person names the exact tag.
